abilities.name: Navigate
abilities.function: Travel toward a self-chosen coordinate or known object/item using observed obstacles.
abilities.costs: Actual distance times 2, increased by carried mass; speed 0.8 per simulation time unit.
abilities.effects: Continues until within the target interaction area or a real failure. Empty target uses x/y. A resource:ID target selects only a remembered ground stack.

execution.progress: repeat counts complete executions. Continuing work retains resolved identity and progress; cancellation releases surviving unconsumed escrow once. Global pauses preserve all work and costs.

abilities.name: Rest
abilities.function: Recover available physical energy at the current position.
abilities.effects: Base recovery 4, modified by actually accessible registered facilities; capped at 40.

abilities.name: Wait

execution.progress: repeat counts complete executions. Continuing work retains resolved identity and progress; cancellation releases surviving unconsumed escrow once. Global pauses preserve all work and costs.

abilities.name: Pick up

execution.progress: repeat counts complete executions. Continuing work retains resolved identity and progress; cancellation releases surviving unconsumed escrow once. Global pauses preserve all work and costs.

abilities.name: Eat
abilities.effects: Actual nutrition and toxicity apply. Food never directly heals. resource:ID selects an owned stack.

execution.progress: repeat counts complete executions. Continuing work retains resolved identity and progress; cancellation releases surviving unconsumed escrow once. Global pauses preserve all work and costs.

abilities.name: Gather accessible material

abilities.costs: 2 energy per unit, finite current source stock.
abilities.effects: Transfers real source stock to inventory; requires the source interaction range. No processing or felling is implied.

execution.progress: repeat counts complete executions. Continuing work retains resolved identity and progress; cancellation releases surviving unconsumed escrow once. Global pauses preserve all work and costs.

abilities.name: Drop
abilities.function: Place owned units on the ground.
abilities.effects: Other actors may subsequently collect the ground stack.

execution.progress: repeat counts complete executions. Continuing work retains resolved identity and progress; cancellation releases surviving unconsumed escrow once. Global pauses preserve all work and costs.

abilities.name: Give
abilities.function: Hand owned units to an adjacent actor.

execution.progress: repeat counts complete executions. Continuing work retains resolved identity and progress; cancellation releases surviving unconsumed escrow once. Global pauses preserve all work and costs.

abilities.name: Message
abilities.function: Send a short message to a currently visible actor.

execution.progress: repeat counts complete executions. Continuing work retains resolved identity and progress; cancellation releases surviving unconsumed escrow once. Global pauses preserve all work and costs.

abilities.name: Learn a public interface
abilities.function: Study an already implemented ability with its declared prerequisites.
abilities.costs: The interface-specific number of simulation rounds.
abilities.effects: Implementation does not grant mastery. Already mastered interfaces are reused without new rewards.

execution.progress: repeat counts complete executions. Continuing work retains resolved identity and progress; cancellation releases surviving unconsumed escrow once. Global pauses preserve all work and costs.

abilities.name: Request a capability
abilities.function: Describe an encountered problem, desired effect and known conditions for functional review.
abilities.costs: A game round to begin study after review; implementation time does not advance simulation.
abilities.effects: World review reuses equivalents or returns a structured development request. No request, learning or descriptive reward. Unknown methods and costs are allowed; the reviewer supplies a minimal feasible specification.

execution.progress: repeat counts complete executions. Continuing work retains resolved identity and progress; cancellation releases surviving unconsumed escrow once. Global pauses preserve all work and costs.

abilities.name: probe
abilities.function: Observe a nearby subject or physically test a small owned material sample.
abilities.costs: One round; actual observation or communication effort 0.2, physical trials 0.5 energy and 0.1 actual material unit.
abilities.effects: Only measured facts and performed interactions take effect. No mature capability or mastery is supplied.

abilities.name: exchange
abilities.function: Offer a personally tested finding or independently accept an actual nearby offer.
abilities.costs: One round; actual observation or communication effort 0.2, physical trials 0.5 energy and 0.1 actual material unit.
abilities.effects: Only measured facts and performed interactions take effect. No mature capability or mastery is supplied.

execution.progress: One complete low-cost interaction; repetition performs a new interaction with its actual costs.

abilities.name: name
abilities.function: Give a name of up to 60 characters to this place (empty subject) or to a visible object or nearby item; naming the same subject again replaces your name for it.
abilities.costs: One round; no energy or material.
abilities.effects: Leaves a persistent name sign where you stand that nearby people can see. No physical effect.

abilities.name: mark
abilities.function: Leave a mark or inscription of up to 120 characters on the ground here (empty subject) or on an object or item within reach.
abilities.costs: One round; no energy or material.
abilities.effects: Leaves a persistent mark sign where you stand that nearby people can see; your 24 most recent names and marks persist. No physical effect.

abilities.name: tell
abilities.function: Say up to 240 characters aloud; everyone living within 5 units hears it, seen or not.
abilities.costs: One round; no energy or material.
abilities.effects: Each listener receives a heard event and keeps it in a short heard list. Nothing persists at the place. No physical effect.

abilities.name: invite
abilities.function: Invite listeners to meet at a place and a later round within 200 rounds, with an optional note of up to 120 characters.
abilities.costs: One round; no energy or material.
abilities.effects: Heard like tell, and leaves an invitation sign where you stand until 10 rounds after the meeting. At that round an attendance event records who is within 2.5 units of the place. No physical effect.

satisfaction.name: Confirmed understanding
satisfaction.rationale: A real experiment confirmed new information; repeated facts do not qualify.

satisfaction.name: Participating in an evidence exchange
satisfaction.rationale: Separate offer and acceptance around an actual finding; no relation or physical agreement is invented.

args.text: Hello, I'm Moss. I'd like to get to know you. I'm gathering some meadow roots nearby; they're a food I know is safe. Does anyone want company or have a place they'd like to meet?
Hello, I'm Kai. Berries are the food I currently know is safe. I'll take a modest share and leave some for others. I'd welcome sharing tested food knowledge and ideas for a fair camp.

notes: Berries are known to provide 8 nutrition with zero toxicity; hazelnut food properties are not yet known.
Keep some berries in reserve; let the hazelnut observation inform the next choice.
preferences: Prefer independent exploration with a food and energy reserve.
Test unfamiliar foods rather than assuming they are safe.

projects.question: Which nearby foods can support safe, varied meals?

projects.uncertainty: Hazelnut nutrition, toxicity and processing needs are unknown.
projects.goal: Establish reliable food options while preserving room to explore.
projects.missing: Personal observation and, if needed, a small physical trial of unfamiliar foods.
projects.next: Collect safe berries and observe the hazelnut plant.
projects.benefit: A reliable food reserve would make independent exploration safer.

lin.cares: Staying alive and capable, having freedom to wander, and discovering what this place offers without needless risk.

notes: Roots are the only food whose nutrition and lack of toxicity I currently know.

args.function: Learn a feasible practical method for propagating and tending edible meadow roots for a future food supply.
args.conditions: I am near an observed meadow-root plant on ordinary soil in spring. Roots are known to provide 14 nutrition with zero toxicity. Whether harvested roots can propagate, and the requirements for cultivation, are unknown.
args.inputs: Potentially harvested roots and a suitable nearby soil location; actual required materials and tools are unknown.

reviews.reason: The related-capability search found no cultivation equivalent. Gather transfers existing ripe stock; probe can inspect or test samples but does not establish planted material or maintain a growing plot. Develop a general cultivation operation, initially executable as a small planting-and-establishment trial. Edibility and zero toxicity do not establish that detached harvested roots can propagate. Resolve propagation and growth against the implementation facts in the current-conversation development handoff, without granting a crop, materials, knowledge or mastery now. Implemented at the preserved round boundary.
reviews.experienceReview: No benefit for requesting, registration, naming, study completion or purported mastery. A measured viability result, visible establishment or informative physical failure may qualify as verified information gain only when new to this actor and supported by an observation event. Deduplicate equivalent findings across probe and cultivation; repeated inspection without changed evidence grants nothing. If the established experience code supports such events, use at most one short-pleasure unit per distinct verified finding with a 10-round same-function cooldown. Completed, personally applicable care may sustain modest satisfaction through legitimate familiar practice: at most one contribution per 10 rounds, capped at 1 total cultivation satisfaction and decaying by 0.002 per elapsed round without qualifying maintenance. Route these through existing bounded experience rules, not protected reward accounts, budget, goals or permissions; do not create an account merely to award them. Planting or a failed trial provides no nutrition or automatic comfort. Physical comfort remains capped at 10, and mood never reduces basic nutritional requirements.
reviews.visualReview: Emit observable events only after the corresponding physical change: site_prepared, propagule_planted, treatment_applied, condition_observed, establishment_observed, trial_failed and, only when implemented and achieved, crop_matured. Include reusable metadata for plot/source IDs, coordinates, material and quantity, actual stage, work progress, timestamp and observation scope. Reuse plant/plot rendering with state labels such as prepared, planted-unverified, visibly sprouting, stressed or dead; unverified planting must not use the existing ready visual or show harvestable stock. Display growth only from real supported state transitions. Interrupted work shows retained partial progress; invalid actions show no planted or successful-treatment event. Failure observations describe what was seen and do not visually assert an untested biological cause. Private condition data and future hazards must not leak through labels or graphics.
reviews.specification:
General operation: Cultivate plants, parameterized by mode (plant, tend, inspect, end), actual source-material reference, quantity, plot reference or visible soil coordinate, and actual tending inputs. It applies to compatible plants and propagules rather than only meadow roots. Reuse and record existing targeting, inventory accounting, work, environmental updates and probe observation code; use gather unchanged for any genuinely exposed ripe harvest. Do not claim those functions as new development.
Prerequisites: individual study; actor alive, able to act and within interaction reach; actual accessible soil and lawful control of any consumed material. A planting trial may use one whole owned root whose identity, condition and quantity are checked at execution. Neither a regenerative crown nor a viable bud is inferred from the resource name. Candidate reference item-4-wren-47 currently holds three root units with recorded decay, but these are not reserved by this review. Source start-0-roots is an observed mature plant, not free planting stock: its two stock units remain untouched unless a separate valid gather action occurs. Nearby observed plants similarly confer no inputs. Recorded soil value 0.65 is evidence about those plants, not proof that an arbitrary destination is suitable.
Smallest executable version: prepare a small soil location by hand and plant one actual whole root as a labeled experimental propagule, preserving its identity and condition. One root per trial avoids assuming that cut pieces regenerate. No tool is mandatory for loose, hand-workable soil; hard ground or inaccessible roots require actual appropriate tools or fail validation. Planting takes two active rounds and 3 energy total, charged as 1.5 per completed round: first prepare and record the site, then transfer the root into the plot. Validate location, occupancy and input again before transfer. No water, fertilizer or tool is conjured. The root leaves inventory and cannot simultaneously be eaten or used elsewhere. Retain its material quantity and food condition in the plot ledger; planting creates no extra nutrition or mature plant stock.
Implementation handoff must inspect the actual plant, resource and environmental handlers and establish whether detached roots, intact crowns, division or some other real propagule are supported. If the root is unsuitable, report that finding when physically established; do not silently convert it into seed. If viability is unresolved, the supported product is a planted trial, not a promised crop. A non-destructive visible inspection costs one round and 0.2 energy using recorded probe logic; it reveals only presently observable condition. A destructive sample uses probe's existing one-round, 0.5-energy, 0.1-material-unit contract and debits the planted specimen. This is not automatic proof of propagation.
Production support requires a coded species-compatible establishment/growth rule before activation. The handoff must supply exact propagule requirements, growth duration, suitable temperature/moisture/soil ranges, environmental stress and decay, biomass accounting and finite yield from the authoritative implementation facts. Do not invent these from the known nutrition value or label. If those mechanisms cannot yet be grounded, enable the physical planting/monitoring precursor only, explicitly showing that future food production remains unverified. This restriction is not a permanent rejection of cultivation. No generic fixed-era unlock or invented sequence of activities is required.
Tending is an explicit action, not a free background benefit: one round and 1 energy per plot treatment, plus the exact measured quantity of any supplied water or other supported input. Treatment is enabled only when its material requirements and effect are implemented; dry hand movement cannot increase moisture. Reject invalid treatment before costs. Existing passive environmental rules continue to affect planted material, including its condition and any applicable drought or waterlogging, without revealing unobserved future hazards. Once supported growth exists, elapsed simulation time and actual conditions, not repeated requests or inspections, advance it. Photosynthesis must require actual light and suitable conditions, water and nutrients must have declared sources and accounting, and harvested stock must be debited from finite grown biomass. No root multiplication solely from waiting, planting, naming or paying energy.
Persist plot identity, coordinates, source stack identity, transferred quantity, condition, preparation/planting work, treatments, observation times and any implemented growth state. Interrupted work retains completed preparation and paid effort. Resumption revalidates reach, site and surviving inputs; it neither repeats charges for completed work nor skips remaining work. Cancellation before transfer leaves the root in inventory; after transfer it remains physically planted. There is no automatic root or energy refund. Any unconsumed reserved inputs are released once, never duplicated. Ending the trial stops active work but does not erase material or environmental consequences. Death stops the actor's work and releases surviving reservations under ordinary death/drop rules; an existing plot remains subject to world processes. Independent actors may tend it only through their own authorized actions. No consent, assistance or communication is inferred. Review/development waiting advances neither world time nor growth. Learning itself supplies no plot or inputs.

reviews.experienceReview: Four individual study rounds teach the implemented method, not construction mastery; requests, review, reading the contract and study grant no pleasure or satisfaction. Default construction and inspection experience payout is zero. A verified new finding from a real material, ground or exposure trial, including informative failure, may use an existing bounded information-gain rule if applicable, deduplicated by fact and conditions; no new reward currency or account edits are authorized. Familiar successful maintenance can qualify for modest benefit only through an existing coded personal-practice rule with amount, cap, decay and cooldown; otherwise award none. Actual resting comfort requires the actor to occupy the measured protected location under applicable conditions, deduplicates overlapping protection and is capped at 10 total physical comfort. reviews.visualReview: Emit observable events for trial results, material allocation, completed work stages, pause/resume, failed checks, completion, damage, repair and dismantling. Reusable visual metadata includes project/structure ID, operation type, position, orientation, measured width/height, porosity, installed-piece geometry, material appearance, stage, integrity and status: planned, in-progress, unstable, complete, damaged or dismantled. A plan is only a non-solid outline; installed pieces appear only after paid work and transfer. Render the woven screen only to actual completion, never show shelter or success effects on a failed trial or incomplete assembly, and never visualize unmeasured wind reduction as fact. Exposure indicators require actual localized measurements and current conditions. Reuse existing material, project and event rendering components where available and record that reuse in implementation.
reviews.specification:
Implement Construct branch screen as a general operation with modes assess, assemble, inspect, repair and dismantle, parameterized by site coordinates, orientation, explicit owned input-stack IDs and quantities, or an existing project/structure ID. Applicable actors learn it independently. Minimum supported product is an unroofed, approximately 0.9 m wide and 0.4–0.45 m high porous woven branch screen; no shelter, roof, fire protection or storm resistance is implied. Use a deterministic implementation of suitability, work, stability, damage and exposure, not repeated model judgments. Dependencies are actual spatial reach/occupancy, inventory transfers, material properties, ground resistance and measured weather/exposure. If these mechanisms are missing, implement the necessary bounded checks in this handoff; never substitute successful construction for unavailable evidence.
Material recipe: three sound naturally pointed upright pieces about 0.65–0.75 m long and 2–3 cm thick, inserted at least 0.25 m into suitable soil at approximately 0, 0.45 and 0.9 m along the screen, plus eight sound flexible rods about 1.0–1.2 m long and 1–2 cm thick. Alternate weaving around the three uprights, retaining ends and leaving distributed openings rather than making a solid wall. Confirm actual fit, spring-back and retention during assembly. These are eleven qualifying pieces, not automatically eleven resource units: preserve actual inventory quantities and mass, and establish how existing branch units map to pieces before committing a recipe. No cutting, sharpening, cord, tools, stones or water are supplied or assumed. No other material is required for this version if hand insertion and weaving genuinely work. If suitable pieces or soil are unavailable, assess records the measured deficiency and permits only the feasible ground/support trial, not a completed windbreak.
Site: a reachable, clear footprint at least 1.2 by 0.6 m beside, not across, the resting location; no occupied path, entrance, person, protected vegetation or living-tree attachment. Check lawful access under existing permissions rather than granting permission. Ground must admit hand insertion and then retain the posts without loose, saturated or rocky failure. Maintain a clear resting area beyond the possible fall footprint. Orient using actual local wind observations; do not assume a prevailing direction. Initial assess takes one round and 0.2 energy for visible conditions, using probe-compatible observation. A physical support trial takes one round and 0.5 energy and requires one suitable owned post. Record actual insertion, resistance and any damage; an intact post remains recoverable, and any breakage becomes tracked damaged material. It does not consume the baseline probe sample automatically or create a support.
Acquisition uses gather with exact visible source IDs, for example start-2-branches, forest-branch-0, canopy-41 or canopy-69, subject to current stock, reach and the full gather contract. Do not reserve or reveal unobserved stock. Gather costs 2 energy per transferred resource unit and one round per execution. Eleven qualifying one-unit pieces would therefore cost 22 energy, plus actual travel and handling; suitability is not guaranteed. Navigation retains navigate/base:navigate:1 travel costs. Sol owns berries, not construction inputs, and has energy 40; do not automatically gather, spend berries or assume enough energy for every stage without rest.
After learning and a valid trial, assemble requires all specified pieces owned and in reach. Allocate them once to a visible project with exact source-stack provenance; subtract them from freely usable inventory without duplicating material. Eight paid work rounds at 1.5 energy each: two rounds seating and checking uprights, four weaving and retaining rods, one gap/alignment correction and one stability check. Each stage records installed pieces and observable progress. These are active-work minima; failed fit, additional gathering, travel or waiting takes real additional time. Require sufficient energy before each paid round. Perform a low-force hand stability check and record displacement and loose components against a coded acceptance threshold appropriate to the declared dimensions and actual ground/material properties. Completion requires every connection and support passing; a failed check leaves an incomplete or unstable structure, not success. No guaranteed wind-reduction percentage is assigned.
Leaving reach, insufficient energy, occupancy changes or an invalid site pauses before further work and without additional charge. Resume by project ID after rechecking site, inputs, integrity and energy; retain completed work and costs. Cancel stops queued work, returns uninstalled surviving escrow once, and leaves installed pieces as an explicitly incomplete physical project until dismantled. Death stops work; uninstalled escrow becomes recoverable material at the work/death location under existing ownership/death rules, while installed material remains in place. Never refund spent time or energy. Global pauses preserve progress and costs. Prevent concurrent use of allocated material and double returns.
Inspect takes one reachable round and 0.2 energy and reports only observable integrity, gaps and local exposure. Repair specifies damaged components and owned replacements; one removal and one fitting round per replaced piece, each 1.5 energy, followed by the one-round 1.5-energy stability check. Reuse intact components; preserve removed broken material as debris with its remaining mass and properties. Dismantle takes one round per three installed pieces, rounded up, at 1 energy per round; recover only actually surviving pieces, decrementing the structure as each group is removed. No energy, time or damage refund.
A completed screen persists physically without continued work but is checked by ongoing weather, collision and decay rules. Its solids affect passage only at actual occupied geometry. Wind effects apply only to reachable occupied locations in its small leeward footprint, using current wind direction/speed, height, porosity and integrity; absent a credible local exposure calculation, show an unverified screen and allow measured exposure comparison, not a fabricated shelter bonus. No roof, rainproofing, heating or food is produced. Wind shifts remove coverage; breakage or loosened posts reduce or end it immediately and can leave fallen material. Inspection is advisable after gusts and before use; there is no automatic repair or recurring material charge without work. Use rest (base:rest:1; forest.rest, foundation-forest@1) unchanged unless its implemented facility/exposure rules actually recognize this structure; never stack duplicate rest or comfort bonuses.

reviews.specification:
Develop hand-weave-fiber-mat(target, materials, mode, position), applicable to any learner and suitable accessible fibrous plant material, with modes test, assemble/resume, inspect, trial, repair, place, dismantle and cancel. Smallest product: one unbacked, hand-plaited portable sitting mat, nominally 0.45 x 0.45 m; no loom, cutting tool, cordage, adhesive or tree damage is assumed. Dependencies and exact references: reuse gather/base:gather:1 (handler forest.gather, foundation-forest@1) for collection, probe/open-baseline:probe:1 for observation/material trials, and existing pickup/drop/navigation rules for movement and transfer. Record any actual shared code reuse in the implementation manifest, including validation, item provenance and work-state code; do not describe this as reinventing those functions. branch-screen/shelter:woven-branch-windbreak:1 is a related non-equivalent reference, not a license to inherit its wind protection. The only identified candidate source is forest-dry-grass-0 at (14.2,16.3); it is not owned material. Collecting each unit costs one gather round and 2 energy, subtracting finite source stock in interaction range. Do not expose additional source facts or pre-commit its observed stock. Existing owned roots are not suitable inputs.
Prerequisites: completed individual study; reachable owned uncommitted material; free hands; a clear accessible working patch; enough energy for the next paid step. Test uses one actual 0.1-unit sample, one round and 0.5 energy through probe. Observe length, brittleness, moisture, bendability and whether hand-twisting and crossing strands produces a retaining edge. The sample becomes identified tested scraps, not an unexplained disappearance. Test passes only where actual stems can overlap into continuous strips, bend through the needed crossings without breaking, and retain their own tucked ends under gentle handling. No inferred suitability from the source name. Store measured results with sample provenance, method and material applicability; reassess degraded or materially different batches. The handoff must implement observable material-test outcomes, not ask the model to approve each attempt. If retained plaiting is infeasible, the test is the executable precursor; report why and leave manufacture unavailable for that material without permanently rejecting the general operation.
Assembly recipe: reserve exactly 4 whole suitable gathered units, separate from the test sample. These are a recipe allocation, not a guarantee of sufficient fiber. A dry layout must demonstrate enough usable stems to cover the nominal footprint in two crossing layers with overlapping ends and tucked edges. No unspecified unit-to-length or mass conversion may be invented: use actual resource geometry/properties established in implementation; if unavailable, implement the sample test first and report unresolved yield. Layout takes one round and 0.5 energy. Insufficient quantity or length produces a measured shortfall and no mat; release surviving reserved material once. A feasible layout proceeds through six paid rounds at 1 energy each: two strip-forming, three interlacing/edge-tucking, one lift-and-integrity check. Each paid round records its physical changes and costs once. Output passes only if it retains the footprint when lifted and laid down and has no major opening wider than 0.03 m. Otherwise it remains a loose or failed workpiece, not a completed mat.
Maintain a work record containing owner, exact input stack IDs and quantities, source provenance, material age/condition, sample result, location, reserved versus incorporated quantities, stage, paid progress and output identity. Each transfer subtracts that quantity from the source inventory; final material accounting is input = fiber retained in mat + recoverable offcuts + damaged scraps. Weaving cannot create biomass, reset decay or copy inventory. Preserve actual mass, moisture and provenance through processing. No food or nutrition is produced. Output remains an owned, portable physical item with measured dimensions, condition and actual fiber content, subject to existing carrying limits.
Insufficient energy, leaving reach, unavailable material or occupied workspace pauses before charging the next step; already performed steps persist. Resume revalidates conditions and starts at the recorded unpaid step. Manual interruption has the same behavior. Cancel costs no energy and releases unincorporated reserved inputs once; a partial workpiece and scraps stay real and recoverable at the site. Death stops work, releases reservations at the death/work location consistently with actual custody, and leaves physical workpieces rather than duplicating them. No time or energy refund; no restoration of damaged fibers. Global simulation pauses preserve work without ageing or charges.
Inspect costs one round and 0.2 energy and records visible dimensions, moisture, gaps and condition without repairing anything. Place or lift costs one round and 0.2 energy, requires reach and a clear footprint outside obstructed movement space, and transfers the same item rather than creating a fixture. Dismantle costs one round and 0.5 energy, producing the actual recoverable fibers and scraps, with no restoration of consumed effort or broken stems. Repair requires an identified damaged area and one suitable owned unit per repair session: two rounds at 1 energy each to remove damaged fibers and interlace replacements, followed by the ordinary one-round, 1-energy integrity check. Replacement inputs must physically suffice; record unused surplus and removed scraps, and never increase condition or area beyond what the actual repaired weave supports.
Physical trial requires a completed mat, clear dry firm ground, and an actor independently choosing to sit on it for one round at 0.2 energy. Record flattening, slipping, breakage and skin-contact suitability. A passing trial requires retained weave under that actor's actual load, no slipping, and no sharp or irritating contacts. Only that demonstrated applicable load range permits a modest +0.5 physical-comfort contribution while actually sitting on the dry intact mat on such ground; total physical comfort is capped at 10 and equivalent cushioning contributions deduplicate rather than stack. Wet, displaced, damaged or untested conditions give no such contribution. Initial version has zero thermal-insulation, rain, wind, medical or nutrition effect; these cannot be inferred from appearance. No automatic sitting, belonging, attendance or social response. Any neighbor must communicate, approach and act independently.
Ongoing processes run in code only while world time advances: retain material moisture/decay behavior, plus mat-condition loss of 0.0005 per exposed round and 0.002 per occupied sitting round, clamped to [0,1]. At condition below 0.5 disable the comfort effect and mark integrity as needing repair/retrial. Wetting immediately suspends the dry-use effect; drying must arise from actual environmental exposure, not a free maintenance command. Damaged or degraded material is not renewed by inspection or relocation. No passive production, automatic repair or hidden maintenance supplies.

args.text: The approach I tried is blocked, so I'll rest here within speaking distance rather than crowd the plants or your work. Quiet company still sounds good; there's no need to bring anything.

notes: The failed approach does not establish that every route is blocked; remain at the current safe position for now.
Use four of the six carried berries during this plan, leaving two if the stack remains usable. No benefit from the distant mat is assumed.
preferences: Leave shared plants, work areas and paths accessible.
Choose unhurried companionship without assuming it produces a particular feeling.

plan.intention: Turn the successfully tested reeds into one mat, then eat and recover before inspecting and physically trialling the result.
notes: The assembly square is near my current position and away from the visible reed plants; the interface must validate its clearance.
Assembly includes its own paid stages and lift check. A finished mat still needs inspection and a separate sitting trial; no comfort or shelter effect is established.
preferences: Prefer measured practical competence to untested claims.

projects.question: Can I personally make a sound hand-plaited sitting mat from locally available fiber?
evidence: Personal mastery of hand-weave-fiber-mat completed at tick 69.
At tick 78 a physical 0.1-unit sample from forest-reed-0 passed the plaiting test: strips formed and a tucked edge held.
The tested reed sample had flexibility 0.7, strength 0.1 and was not brittle; the test did not represent stem length or moisture.
The remaining intact reed stack contains 4.9 units.
projects.uncertainty: A passing sample does not establish successful full assembly or sitting performance.
projects.goal: Complete one mat and test its structural performance.
completedSteps: Gathered reeds and physically tested a small sample successfully.
outputs: Verified source-specific plaiting test recorded at tick 78.
projects.missing: Completed assembly, inspection and physical sitting trial.
projects.next: Assemble using four intact tested-source reed units, then inspect the actual output and trial it under suitable conditions.
projects.benefit: The small trial established that these reeds can form strips and retain a tucked edge before committing four units.
